title: Ubiquitous Mexican Beef Fajita-Style Jjigae
description: A fusion of Mexican and Korean flavors in a savory, juicy, and indulgent fajita-style dish.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large tagine over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they're translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the flank steak and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it's browned and cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Add the cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the malt vinegar and gochujang, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef and vegetables hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
